method: Native host material-preparation ablation with identical CUDA kernels. Four independent scenes, eight solids per scene. Three warmed alternating-order repetitions. Full wall includes preparation, graph capture, stepping and output transfers. Cold compilation/context, validation and disk writes excluded. Host voxelization time is nested inside full wall. Torch peak allocation excludes host memory, context, driver and graph allocations outside the allocator. Bitwise checks cover epsilon, complete final E/H, point signals, times, snapshots, complex plane fields and flux. No external-library speed or general mesh-accuracy claim.
